versions.content: The maximum number of negative responses with NRC 0x78 can be configured using the optional configuration parameter DcmDslDiagRespMaxNum- RespPend (see ECUC_Dcm_00693). If this parameter is not configured, the default amount of negative responses with NRC 0x78 is infinite.
